name: Special Encounter Report
query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(pe.practitioner_name, pe.practitioner) AS "Consultant:Data:220",
    pe.patient AS "Patient ID:Link/Patient:150",
    COALESCE(p.patient_name, pe.patient_name) AS "Patient Name:Data:220",
    COALESCE(pe.patient_age, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.dob, pe.encounter_date)) AS "Age:Data:100",
    COALESCE(p.sex, pe.patient_sex) AS "Sex:Data:90",
    dd.differential_diagnosis AS "Differential Diagnosis:Data:300",
    pe.encounter_date AS "Date:Date:110",
    p.territory AS "Territory:Link/Territory:160"
FROM `tabPatient Encounter` pe
INNER JOIN `tabPatient` p
    ON p.name = pe.patient
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        parent,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT diagnosis ORDER BY idx SEPARATOR ', ') AS differential_diagnosis
    FROM `tabPatient Encounter Diagnosis`
    WHERE parenttype = 'Patient Encounter'
      AND parentfield = 'differential_diagnosis'
    GROUP BY parent
) dd ON dd.parent = pe.name
WHERE pe.docstatus < 2
  AND pe.encounter_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY pe.encounter_date DESC, pe.encounter_time DESC, pe.creation DESC
